title: Nimble Crisp Mediterranean Seafood Toast
description: A low-calorie, wine-infused Mediterranean dish featuring seafood stock, toast, and a variety of seafood, perfect for a solo dinner, served on a lazy-susan-spinner for a fun and interactive meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the bread into 1/2-inch thick slices and toast until crispy.
In a large pot, combine the seafood stock, white wine, lemon juice, and garlic, and bring to a boil.
Add the shrimp, mussels, and clams to the pot, cover, and cook for 5 minutes, or until the seafood is cooked through.
Stir in the olive oil and parsley.
To assemble the dish, place a slice of toasted bread on each plate, then spoon the seafood and broth over the top.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Place the plates on a lazy-susan-spinner for a fun and interactive meal.
